column1: Replace <unique> with your own short tag. Full text: docs/AZURE_DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md in the repository.

column4: Action and values
Install the repository (python scripts/dev.py setup) and PostgreSQL 16 or newer. Make two random values: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(48))".
Run python scripts/package_azure_kudu.py. Never zip with Explorer or Finder.
Set ATLAS_ADMIN_USERNAME and ATLAS_ADMIN_PASSWORD, then run python scripts/dev.py azure-local --check.
Name rg-agentic-qe, Region East US 2. Review + create, Create.
Name kv-agentic-qe-<unique>, East US 2, Pricing tier Standard, Permission model: Azure role-based access control.

column3: Vault > Access control (IAM) > Add role assignment
column4: Role Key Vault Secrets Officer for your own account.
Add atlas-admin-password (12+ characters) and atlas-secret-key (the random value).

column3: Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible servers > Create
column4: Name pg-agentic-qe-<unique>, East US 2, version 17, Workload Development, Configure server: Burstable, Standard_B1ms, 32 GiB, backup 7 days. PostgreSQL authentication only. Networking: Public access (allowed IP addresses), Azure services access off.
Name agentic_qe.
atlas-database-url = postgresql://<user>:<password>@pg-agentic-qe-<unique>.postgres.database.azure.com:5432/agentic_qe?sslmode=require (percent-encode @ : / ? # in the password).
Name stagenticqe<unique>, East US 2, Standard, LRS. Data protection: blob versioning on, soft delete 7 days.
Allow Blob anonymous access: Enabled. Save.
Name downloads, Anonymous access level: Blob (never Container).
Upload the DMGs, zips, MSI and latest.json from GitHub Release v0.1.0 with Overwrite on. Set latest.json Cache-Control to no-cache. Copy the container URL.
column5: <container URL>/latest.json opens in a private window.

column4: Name plan-agentic-qe, Linux, East US 2, Pricing plan Basic B1.
Name aqe-api-<unique>, Publish Code, Python 3.12, Linux, East US 2, plan plan-agentic-qe.
System assigned: On. Then on the vault, role Key Vault Secrets User for this managed identity.
column5: Role assignment listed on the vault.

column4: Startup Command python /home/site/wwwroot/startup.py; Always on On; HTTPS Only On.

ATLAS_KEY_VAULT_URL, ATLAS_PROFILE=web, ATLAS_DATA_DIR=/home/atlas/data, ATLAS_ADMIN_USERNAME, ATLAS_ALLOWED_HOSTS, ATLAS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS, ATLAS_MAX_SANDBOXES=5, WEBSITES_ENABLE_APP_SERVICE_STORAGE=true, WEBSITES_PORT=8000, SCM_DO_BUILD_DURING_DEPLOYMENT=false, ENABLE_ORYX_BUILD=false.
Drag dist/azure_backend.zip onto the page, then Restart the app.
column5: Log stream: 'Environment built', then 'Starting API on port 8000'.

column4: Copy all outbound and additional outbound IP addresses.
Add one firewall rule per address (start = end), Save, restart the API app.
Name aqe-ui-<unique>, Node 20 LTS, Linux, East US 2, plan plan-agentic-qe. Startup Command node /home/site/wwwroot/startup.js; Always on and HTTPS Only On.
ATLAS_BACKEND_URL, ATLAS_DOWNLOADS_URL (container URL, no trailing slash), WEBSITES_ENABLE_APP_SERVICE_STORAGE=true, WEBSITES_PORT=3000, SCM_DO_BUILD_DURING_DEPLOYMENT=false, ENABLE_ORYX_BUILD=false.
Drag dist/azure_frontend.zip onto the page, then Restart.
column5: Log stream ends with 'Starting UI on port 3000'; landing page shows downloads.

column4: Unmatched rule action Deny; one Allow rule per UI outbound address; Advanced tool site: allow only your IP.
